dog.description_text:
Meet Mini Fridge, a 4.5 month, 18 pound (as of 11/14) pup who might just be the funnest dude in town. Part Beagle, part collie, and part goof-ball, this guy is high energy all the way. And he’ll keep you amused morning, noon, and night!

Mini Fridge is still too young to take leash walks, but once he is able to, he’s going to love breathing in the fresh air and getting all his steps in. He’s still learning boundaries around older, more impatient dogs, but Mini Fridge would likely have a blast horsing around with another young exuberant dog who can keep up with him. He’s a party boy, through and through!

When Mini Fridge isn’t playing with toys...and he absolutely LOVES toys of ANY kind...he turns into a little love machine. He adores humans, and as such, this fella thrives on being pet, cuddled with, massaged, scratched, and caressed. No area is off limits for him. He is a love sponge, soaking up every bit of affection that comes his way. He even enjoys being held like a baby! That is, until he becomes too big to be held!

If you have an active lifestyle and the time to train this utterly amazing creature, Mini Fridge will be that dog that everyone wishes they had. He is handsome, intelligent, sweet, kind, loving...and a gifted comedian who wears a fur suit!

If you would like to adopt this wonderful dog, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
dog.name: Mini Fridge
